subject: Gap-to-Commit play & sprintboard: Q4 coverage compression
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Gap-to-Commit play & sprintboard: Q4 coverage compression

Team —

Heading into the final two weeks of Q4 we still have a ~28% coverage gap vs. quota if we keep current probabilities. I pulled together a lightweight action grid (attached) to compress coverage and create a short sprint focused on high-velocity closes and procurement unblockers. Key asks up front:

- Update SFDC stages for any deal you expect to move to Commit in the next 10 business days. Use Commit / Commit - At Risk / Commit - Confirmed tags so finance can trust the model.
- For deals with procurement outstanding, note the earliest possible PO date and who owns the procurement contact (column in spreadsheet).
- Quick sync: 30 min tomorrow to assign owners and lock sprint board — propose 11:00 PT.

I attached an action grid (Q4_gap_action_grid.xlsx) with a simple prioritization: Close Likelihood, Procurement Risk, Required Legal Redlines, Next Concrete Ask. Please update your rows by 3pm PT today.

Why this matters: we can only compress runway if we aggressively clear procurement and drop low-velocity opportunities from the model (move to Nurture) to improve signal for quarter close.

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: Q4_gap_action_grid.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Jared Lewis <jared.lewis@helioshealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@helioshealth.com>
Date: Sun, 8 Nov 2026 12:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gap-to-Commit play & sprintboard: Q4 coverage compression

Irene —

Thanks for the note and the grid. We’re interested in compressing this but have one procurement constraint: our fiscal-close for vendor onboarding is Nov 30 and procurement needs a finalized SOW + standard procurement packet by Nov 24 to hit that.

Quick answers:
- We can move demoable PoCs to a 60% commit probability if you can confirm delivery SLAs and the SOW by EoD Nov 20.
- Procurement will only sign once legal confirms the data residency and audit clauses — I’ve attached our internal procurement timeline for visibility.

Can we push the sprintboard sync to Mon 11/9 10:30 PT? I’ll have procurement join for the first 10 minutes.

— Jared
Jared Lewis
Head of Security & Procurement, Helios Health
jared.lewis@helioshealth.com

Attachment: Helios_procurement_timeline.pdf (PDF)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Lewis <jared.lewis@helioshealth.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 07:58:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gap-to-Commit play & sprintboard: Q4 coverage compression

Jared —

Appreciate the timeline — that’s workable. From our side I’ll:

1) Pull a single-statement SOW draft that limits the integration scope to our hosted API + 90-day pilot SLA.
2) Flag the data residency language we can accept and the optional add-on for private (VPC) deployment; legal will try to produce a redline by Thu 11/19.
3) Mark the Helios row in the action grid as "Procurement hold -> 11/24 earliest PO" and set Probability = 60% conditional on SOW.

Irene — I’ll own the legal handoff and update the sheet by noon. Vivek — can you confirm if we have any credits or exception path to accelerate procurement (expedited onboarding)?

Monica
Monica Patel
Sr. Deal Desk Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com

(Attachment referenced: updated row in Q4_gap_action_grid.xlsx)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Gap-to-Commit play & sprintboard: Q4 coverage compression

Team —

We have two fast levers to compress coverage this week: credits + short-term commercial flexibility. I can approve a targeted onboarding credit up to $40k for deals that will move to Commit by EoD Nov 24 and where procurement confirms PO window. Conditions:

- Deal must have an internal Exec Sponsor and a PO date in the action grid.
- Legal redlines limited to standard data residency + SOC attestations; no custom indemnity changes.
- Deals using the expedited credit must be marked in SFDC with tag: "Q4_EXPEDITED_ONBOARDING".

Aditya — please run a quick scrub of the top 12 Mid-Market deals and return a short list (3–5) we should prioritize for the sprint by 11:30 PT. I’ll join the 10:30 PT sync for final sign-off.

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@helioshealth.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800

Thanks everyone — quick summary and concrete next steps: 

Sprint sync confirmed: Mon 11/9 10:30 PT (30 min). Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=helios-q4-sprintboard

Action items (owners & deadlines):
- Monica: Legal draft SOW + update action grid row for Helios by 12:00 PT 11/9.
- Aditya: Top-12 scrub -> prioritized 3-5 deals w/ PO windows by 11:30 PT 11/9.
- Vivek: Confirm expedited credit approvals + finalize tag rules by noon 11/9.
- All sellers: Update SFDC stage & probability for any deal you expect to commit in next 10 business days (deadline 15:00 PT 11/9).

If we hit these items we reduce the modeled coverage gap materially and give finance confidence for the EoQ close plan. If any deal cannot meet the procurement timeline, move it to Nurture in SFDC (record reason in the action grid).

I’ll follow up post-sync with a locked sprintboard and a short status note for Finance.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Mid-Market Sales | Redwood Inference
